headline.text: The Spanish Tybost label says plasma concentrations of CYP3A-metabolized drugs, including atazanavir, increase when given with cobicistat.

reported.text: A review reports bioequivalence between cobicistat and ritonavir as an atazanavir pharmacoenhancer.

mechanism.text: The Spanish label links the rise in atazanavir concentrations to cobicistat acting on CYP3A-metabolized drugs.

claims.text: The Spanish Tybost label says plasma concentrations of CYP3A-metabolized drugs, including atazanavir and darunavir, increase when given with cobicistat.
claims.quote: Se observa un aumento de las concentraciones plasmáticas de los medicamentos metabolizados por el CYP3A (entre ellos atazanavir y darunavir) cuando se administran de forma concomitante con cobicistat.
claims.quoteEnglish: An increase in plasma concentrations of drugs metabolized by CYP3A (among them atazanavir and darunavir) is observed when they are administered concomitantly with cobicistat.
claims.judgeRationale: Tybost label states concentrations of CYP3A-metabolized drugs including atazanavir rise with cobicistat; translation is faithful.

claims.text: The Spanish Tybost label says treatment with cobicistat and atazanavir or darunavir in the second and third trimesters of pregnancy produced lower atazanavir or darunavir exposure than postpartum.
claims.quote: Se ha demostrado que el tratamiento con cobicistat y atazanavir o darunavir durante el segundo y tercer trimestre de embarazo produce menores exposiciones a atazanavir o darunavir en comparación con el posparto.
claims.quoteEnglish: Treatment with cobicistat and atazanavir or darunavir during the second and third trimester of pregnancy has been shown to produce lower exposures to atazanavir or darunavir compared with postpartum.
claims.judgeRationale: Tybost label states cobicistat with atazanavir in second and third trimesters produced lower atazanavir exposure than postpartum; translation is faithful.

claims.text: A review says bioequivalence between cobicistat and ritonavir as a pharmacoenhancer of atazanavir was established.
claims.quote: Bioequivalence between cobicistat (COBI) and ritonavir (RTV) as a pharmacoenhancer of ATV was established.
claims.judgeRationale: Review abstract states bioequivalence between cobicistat and ritonavir as atazanavir pharmacoenhancer was established.

gaps.text: The FDA Tybost label excerpts in the packet describe cobicistat with atazanavir mainly in relation to other drugs; no controlled study of atazanavir with cobicistat was among the PubMed records.
